name: Marko Petrović
bio:
Marko Petrović's journey into motorsport security wasn't exactly planned. After a brief stint in the Serbian military police, Marko found himself drawn to the high-octane world of racing, initially as a track marshal. He quickly realized his attention to detail and knack for anticipating potential problems could be invaluable in a more formal security role.

He approaches his work with a calm and methodical demeanor, believing that a well-prepared team and proactive risk assessment are the best defenses against any threat. Marko is currently focused on honing his management skills and learning the intricacies of international racing regulations. He distinguishes himself through his unwavering reliability and commitment to the team's safety, always prioritizing the well-being of everyone involved.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Marko is a stocky man with a serious expression and a strong build.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with security checklists.
Has a habit of double-checking every lock and seal, even if he already did it moments before.
Drinks copious amounts of strong Serbian coffee throughout the day.
